scenes.label: Opening Hook
scenes.audio: If a customer comes to you today and says, 'If you return the commission to me, I'll buy from you.' Would you return it?

scenes.label: Problem Solving
scenes.audio: Okay, this problem. We naturally decide based on the market mechanism. Then we first have to see, under this company system, can I return the commission?

scenes.label: Problem Solving
scenes.audio: We don't do things that violate company policy. But if it is returnable, I believe 99% of sales professionals would return it just to close the deal. Right.

scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.audio: When you have closed the deal for the sake of the return commission... I think... a return, it must be returned. But how to return it, and how to return it more comfortably than others?

scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.audio: This means I can return it, but I can't return as much as others. I still make money because everything I do is meant to stabilize my price.

scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.audio: So I will tell the customer a very classic line, everyone here can learn it. 'If you buy from me today, you won't find the cheapest price in Taiwan, but you won't find the most expensive either. I can only guarantee that after you walk out this door, you won't find a better sales consultant.'

scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.audio: If I am 10,000 dollars different from others, but you get 10 years of service in exchange, do you think it's worth it? Let you decide.

scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.audio: I should be moved to tears! Right! [audience laughter and applause]
